valuation.valuation_commentary: Valuation structure across 5 eligible anchors yields a weighted fair value of $286.47 (-16.95% vs current price $344.92, verdict: overvalued). Intrinsic DCF anchors cluster tightly between $128.66 and $167.28, while analyst price target consensus ($427.55, 50% weight) provides significant upward skew. The Buffett owner earnings multiple anchor ($7.71, 16.67% weight) is heavily distorted by aggressive AI infrastructure CapEx cycles depressing reported free cash flows. Forward validation is classified as STRETCHED: although top-line revenue trajectory (18.8% path) supports current market capitalization relative to analyst CAGR (15.6%), both archetype shadow and forward earnings checks fail, indicating current pricing demands flawless operational execution.

red_team.counter_thesis: 多頭過度聚焦於 17.3x 帳面低 PE 與表面營收增速，卻忽視 AI 資本支出浪潮已將 FCF Yield 壓制至 0.55% 警戒水位，在 2.41% 高實質利率下，現價需隱含 60% 5年 FCF CAGR 的不切實際預期，現金流轉換惡化與折舊遞延將引發強烈估值重估。
kill_conditions: IF 未來 2 季 FCF 年化增速 < 30%（低於現價隱含 60% CAGR 之半數）WITHIN 180 天 THEN 現價隱含超高自由現金流成長預期破滅，低本益比安全邊際論點瓦解
IF 10Y 實質利率維持 > 2.40% 且未來 2 季營收年化增速 < 19% 或營業利益率因 AI 折舊承壓收縮 > 100 bps WITHIN 120 天 THEN 高折現率環境將引發 EV/EBIT 23.8x 向內在價值 $286.47 及 DCF 錨定區間加速修正
IF 股價有效跌破關鍵支撐位 340.88 並在 20D/50D 均線下方確認頭部型態 WITHIN 45 天 THEN 多頭技術結構完全破裂，觸發機構籌碼獲利了結賣壓
